acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given a user session, When interactions occur, Then telemetry is successfully saved in the backend.
Given stored telemetry, When the frontend component loads, Then it correctly displays the retrieved data.
Given this role completes the Atomic Goal, When the relevant verification command runs, Then the change passes without unrelated scope.
Given the change is reviewed, When the PR diff is inspected, Then it contains only source, config, test, or documentation files needed for this slice.
notes: Verified telemetry flow across 35 Java backend tests (including TelemetryControllerTest, TelemetryServiceTest, WorkflowTelemetryVerificationTest, AnalysisSpeedTelemetryVerificationTest, TelemetryValidationTest, TelemetryElapsedTimeVerificationTest, AnalysisSpeedTelemetryUnitTest, DossierTelemetryVerificationTest) and 2 Playwright E2E tests (frontend/e2e/telemetry.spec.mjs).
